name: wikipedia-interest-trends
description: Agent Skill: analyze Wikipedia pageview trends across language editions and produce charts and short reports.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run rebuild && git diff --quiet -- scripts/dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- scripts/dist)" || (echo "scripts/dist does not match scripts/src: stage the rebuilt files." >&2 && exit 1)
